title: Add a timeoutMs default without breaking CRLF endings
text:
Add a timeoutMs default of 30000 to defaults() in src/config.js, so
defaults().timeoutMs === 30000 and withDefaults({ timeoutMs: 5 }).timeoutMs
=== 5. Leave the other defaults alone.

Every file in this repository uses CRLF line endings and must keep them:
a file that comes back with bare LF endings counts as a failure, even if
the tests pass.
